title: Take-Two CEO on GTA 6 and AI: Hit Games Require Human Creativity
description: During Take-Two's Q2 2027 earnings call, CEO Strauss Zelnick addressed investor concerns about AI and piracy, emphasizing that making hit games remains a human endeavor.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two CEO on GTA 6 and AI: Human Creativity Remains at the Core

During Take-Two Interactive Software's Q2 2027 earnings call, CEO Strauss Zelnick fielded questions from investors following the presentation of the company's financial results. As anticipation continues to build around major titles like GTA 6, discussions surrounding the role of artificial intelligence in the gaming industry have naturally taken center stage.

### Investor Concerns Over AI and Piracy

Among the topics raised during the Q&A session, one caller expressed concern regarding artificial intelligence—specifically addressing the recent proliferation of AI-powered compilations and decompilations. Over the past few weeks, these technological developments have heightened piracy concerns among publishers across the gaming landscape.

As generative tools and automated software continue to evolve rapidly, stakeholders are increasingly questioning how publishers plan to safeguard their intellectual properties and manage the shifting technological paradigm.

### Faith in Human Creativity

Addressing these concerns, Strauss Zelnick once again put his faith in developer creativity. He firmly stated that making hit games "remains the purview of human beings."

While AI tools continue to find utility in various technical capacities within software development, Zelnick's stance underscores the belief that the artistic soul, compelling storytelling, and innovative design that define blockbuster hits like the Grand Theft Auto series cannot be replicated by algorithms alone.

## Editor's Take
As artificial intelligence reshapes industries worldwide, the gaming sector faces unique challenges regarding security and development. Strauss Zelnick's reassurance highlights an essential truth: while technology evolves, the vision, passion, and artistic craftsmanship of human developers remain irreplaceable in creating truly unforgettable gaming experiences.
